name: Floor Triceps Dip
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet planted flat, and palms placed on the floor behind your hips with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your palms to lift your hips a few inches off the floor while keeping your chest open.
Bend your elbows straight back behind you to lower your torso until your hips nearly brush the floor.
Press firmly through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the elevated starting position.
tips: Make sure the lowering and lifting come from bending and extending your elbows rather than just dropping and raising your hips.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears and avoid flaring your elbows wide.
